criteria.title: Loading & profiling
criteria.description: Data loaded correctly; shape, types and summary produced; the dataset is described accurately in the student's own words. Assess the written justification and interpretation for this criterion. Numerical checks are scored separately. Do not infer correct code execution from prose. Unverifiable visual, repository-history or model-fitting claims must be flagged as concerns, not awarded as established facts.
